subject: Quick pulse: post-discovery fit + pilot timing for Midwest Analytics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Simmons <alex@midwestanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 May 2028 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + next step suggestion from today's call

Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap to make sure I captured the right pieces and to propose a short next step:  

1) Primary use case: low-latency document understanding for customer support tickets and internal knowledge search (ingest from S3 + periodic batch updates).
2) Performance target: median generation/embedding latency under ~200ms for common queries; some long-form doc processing can be async.
3) Security: VPC/private deployment or dedicated tenancy preferred; SOC2 evidence will be required for procurement.
4) Pilot ask: 4-week technical pilot with a 1–2 model variants, integration via S3 + minimal API changes; success criteria = end-to-end query latency + relevance score uplift on sample prompts.
5) Budget / timeline: tentatively aiming for a pilot start in June; procurement window in July if pilot looks good.

Attached are the discovery notes I took (midwest-discovery-notes.pdf) and a short 1-page quick proposal that outlines a lightweight pilot path and what Redwood would deliver during the 4 weeks (redwood-inference-quick-proposal.pdf).

Would you be open to a 15-minute alignment call next week to confirm the pilot scope and any security/procurement blockers? Here are a couple of slots on my side: Wednesday 5/10 10:00–10:30 CT or Thursday 5/11 15:00–15:30 CT. If neither works, tell me a time that does and I’ll book.

If this isn't a fit, a quick one-line "not a fit" helps us close the loop and avoid chasing.

Thanks — looking forward to your take.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
